text:
Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8 (historical standard offset).  
Europe/London in 1715 would be using local mean time (UTC-0:01:15 approx.), but for simplicity, treat as UTC+0.  

Conversion:  
London time = Shanghai time − 8 hours.  
2:00 − 8 hours = 18:00 previous day (May 13, 1715).  

FINAL_ANSWER: May 13, 1715, 18:00
